answer_line: The model generates MNIST-style handwritten digits downscaled to 12×12. Each image is a single white digit, drawn in strokes about 1–2 pixels thick, roughly centred. The digit spans about 8–10 rows (rows 1–10) and about 6–9 columns, on a black background with a black margin of at least one pixel. Shapes include loops (0, 6, 8, 9), bars and diagonals (1, 7, 4), and curved digits (2, 3, 5).
